name: Rizuhble's Healthy Glow Celeste
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,000 (levels 1-14). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Shining Wonder unlocked. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Mystic Burst. Ultimate (Shining Wonder) is available from Radiant Regeneration.

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spiritual Overflow, 42400.0 souls (~42.4 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spiritual Overflow, 41600.0 souls (~41.6 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Enchanter's Emblem, 8800 souls (~8.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Mystic Regeneration
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Mystic Burst completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Mystic Burst completes 4.8k spirit in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.caption: Imbued on Light Eater: widens its range.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Mystic Burst completes 4.8k spirit in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Radiant Regeneration
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Mystic Burst completes 800 souls on. Upgrade of Mystic Regeneration (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: imminent: Mystic Burst completes 4.8k spirit in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Radiant Daggers (162) clears its 80-damage trigger; Light Eater stays under it.

items.name: Healing Booster
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Enchanter's Emblem, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,000-21,600 (levels 14-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Light Eater T3, Radiant Daggers T3. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Enchanter's Emblem.

items.name: Grit
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Enchanter's Emblem completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Enchanter's Emblem completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Spirit Shielding
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Enchanter's Emblem completes 1,600 souls on. Upgrade of Grit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Enchanter's Emblem completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Torment Pulse
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Shining Wonder bounce radius (15.5m), Dazzling Trick explode radius (14m), Radiant Daggers explosion radius (8m). Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Suppressor
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 10,400 to 12,000 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. | +6 spirit adds about 3.8 to Radiant Daggers's impact damage (0.63x scaling).

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: component_for)

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 21,600-43,200 (levels 26-34). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Shining Wonder T3. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Spiritual Overflow.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 13,600 to 16,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 219s; 20% off is 43.8s per full rotation.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 12,800 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 19,200 to 24,000 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (0 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 0 to 54% weapon damage. Upgrade of Spirit Lifesteal (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Tankbuster? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Suppressor.
sections.desc: Dying after Tankbuster? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Suppressor.

items.name: Ethereal Shift
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They keep jumping you and you can't get out.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry is melting you.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Hexes and slows stop you getting away.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep catching you before you cast.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 24,000 to 30,400 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power. | +30 spirit adds about 31.5 to Shining Wonder's damage (1.05x scaling).

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 189s of base cooldown across your kit, 130s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Takes spirit from 24,000 to 30,400 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power. Replaces Spirit Shielding: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Healing Booster for 4,800 more souls: bonus fire rate 0 to 35; tech resist 0 to 10..

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
